theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+2.30%) and Real Estate (+1.19%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.50%) and Technology (-0.36%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.19%, defensives +0.16%, and value/cyclicals +1.22% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.27%, Dow +0.31%, Nasdaq -0.63% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.73%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 5.37% to 26.80, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 3.03% to $3,656.70, crude oil was little changed at $85.81, and bitcoin gained 1.79% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
